title: Freestanding paper towel holder 14.4-Inch Solid Brass Countertop Stand | Carolina Collection | Allied Brass
description:
Add a refined, space-saving countertop paper towel holder with a freestanding design that needs no mounting. Crafted from solid brass, this Carolina Collection stand holds a roll upright and includes a weighted base for stability while tearing sheets.

Highlights:
- Freestanding paper towel holder keeps a roll accessible on the counter
- Upright, space-saving design helps keep surfaces organized
- Solid brass construction for enduring everyday use
- Felt pad helps prevent scratching on countertop surfaces
- Designer finish is built for corrosion-free, rust-free performance

Specs:
- Collection: Carolina (traditional/classic styling)
- Material: Brass
- Mounting type: Freestanding; assembly required: No
- Overall size: 6.5-Inch L x 6.5-Inch W x 14.4-Inch H (projection 6.5-Inch)
- Product weight: 4 lb; weight capacity: 5 lb
- Included: Paper towel holder
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Finish options: Multiple designer finish options available

_previous.title: Carolina Collection Counter Top Paper Towel Stand
_previous.description: Elegantly hold your paper towel roll on this classic traditional design paper towel stand. Its design is as functional as it is practical. The roll in the stand sits upright on the counter top allowing for space saving. It has a weight in the base to keep the unit stable as you tear off the sheets.
